# [I1 — Changing station network](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_i1.py` from the draft as committed at `680eccf`. Counts of files held in this repository are read live. Counts that session made from external sources or from one-off runs are quotations of that commit - what the draft reported, shown as such, not re-derived by the build.*


**Hypothesis.** Stations were added, moved and dropped over the record, so a published
trend can be a trend in where you looked.

**Prior work this builds on.** Two non-exchangeable observing systems exist ([293](../SOURCES.md#F-5a73e5442d)
summer-peaked, [481](../SOURCES.md#F-020480ee2f) year-round, [1.57](../SOURCES.md#F-c8ed95c900) mg/l apart in Jun–Sep near-bed oxygen, d = [0.66](../SOURCES.md#F-d0a368d5fe)) and
their mixture changes over time. That establishes the *ingredients* of a composition
artefact, not that any published number moved because of it. This draft tests that step.

## 1. The observable consequence, stated so it can fail

Hold the station set fixed and the season fixed, and recompute the Jun–Sep near-bed
oxygen trajectory 1985–2024 in five-year eras.

- **[I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network") is supported** if the era-to-era change measured on the fixed set differs from the
  change measured on the full pooled record by more than the fixed set's own sampling
  band — i.e. the pooled trajectory lies outside the band in at least one era, with the
  discrepancy exceeding [0.2](../SOURCES.md#F-3dbcf1e10c) mg/l (twice the raw quantisation step, §3).
- **[I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network") fails** if the two trajectories track each other inside the band in every era —
  a real possible outcome, and the interesting one: [72](../SOURCES.md#F-a89de496bf)% of observations turned over
  between 1985 and 2024 (§2) without moving the number, and the composition objection
  could be set aside for this variable.

## 2. The data, with counts verified here

`docs/data/areas/stations_series.{json,bin}` — [679,422](../SOURCES.md#F-b61d7944ec) station-months, [1,415](../SOURCES.md#F-fff0060a3d) stations,
[564](../SOURCES.md#F-008df4b99b) months from January 1980, [9](../SOURCES.md#F-81bea72caf) variables; `.bin` is [5,435,376](../SOURCES.md#F-91ec567fa1) bytes, exactly the [8](../SOURCES.md#F-5206f7a514) bytes × Σn
the layout implies. Variable used: `oxy_bed`: **[76,980](../SOURCES.md#F-a95c664ddf) rows, all finite, [1,327](../SOURCES.md#F-a053d110be) stations**.

Jun–Sep, 1985–2024: **[30,460](../SOURCES.md#F-6e6e5995e3) station-months, [1,167](../SOURCES.md#F-5da84ced55) stations**. Per era (n / stations):
1985–1989 [2,589](../SOURCES.md#F-365bb7519a) / [443](../SOURCES.md#F-747122de0b) · 1990–1994 [5,734](../SOURCES.md#F-b458fe8183) / [603](../SOURCES.md#F-7ce9d90f83) · 1995–1999 [4,963](../SOURCES.md#F-1ea7222789) / [563](../SOURCES.md#F-6ed13c8dd8) · 2000–2004 [4,448](../SOURCES.md#F-519f9d5028) / [503](../SOURCES.md#F-a2fd39a5a0) · 2005–2009
[3,635](../SOURCES.md#F-cac2710660) / [379](../SOURCES.md#F-d30aff87fe) · 2010–2014 [3,263](../SOURCES.md#F-6793c09262) / [254](../SOURCES.md#F-02153aab75) · 2015–2019 [2,815](../SOURCES.md#F-d110e4ccd0) / [210](../SOURCES.md#F-42e71d96d0) · 2020–2024 [3,013](../SOURCES.md#F-59c0d31e09) / [211](../SOURCES.md#F-47eeb5b25a). Station count
halves while observation count falls by less — turnover, not merely decline.

**Balanced panel:** stations with ≥1 Jun–Sep `oxy_bed` observation in *every* one of the
eight eras — **[64](../SOURCES.md#F-a758170658) stations, [8,485](../SOURCES.md#F-eb4cdbaac1) station-months**, per-era n from [637](../SOURCES.md#F-5de5294fc8) to [1,156](../SOURCES.md#F-58c6e95b5e). Neither
empty nor degenerate. Its complement, [21,975](../SOURCES.md#F-817fc10a84) of [30,460](../SOURCES.md#F-cf3c02cf3b) Jun–Sep observations (**[72.1](../SOURCES.md#F-c716f70c38)%**),
is what turns over.

**Error classes.**
- Class 3 (aggregation): each row is already a *monthly median per station per depth*.
  Within-month visit count is gone, so [I3](../hypodrafts/I3.md "Changing sampling frequency and season")'s effort confound cannot be controlled inside
  this file: a station visited once and one visited eight times weigh the same.
- Class 2 (quantisation): [62.1](../SOURCES.md#F-6bd9c680d4)% of `oxy_bed` values sit exactly on a [0.1](../SOURCES.md#F-743e7abb4a) mg/l grid and
  [75.0](../SOURCES.md#F-cf212e5e4f)% on [0.05](../SOURCES.md#F-35b345ed6a) — the residual is the median of an even count. Underlying raw is [0.1](../SOURCES.md#F-db33d60f80) mg/l.
- Class 6 (absent dimension): no time-of-day column exists anywhere in the record. Diel
  oxygen swing aliases into whichever hour the boat went, per station, unrecoverably.

**The register does not supply what [I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network") says it supplies.** `data/raw/oda/stations.csv`
(`latin-1`, [798,574](../SOURCES.md#F-4543bdfe7f) rows, [17](../SOURCES.md#F-26ed4e1411) columns, [6,288](../SOURCES.md#F-ef77333c7f) distinct `ObservationsstedNr`) matches only
**[34](../SOURCES.md#F-a05fac31cc) of the [1,415](../SOURCES.md#F-fff0060a3d) series stations**. Worse, `StartDato` equals `SlutDato` on **[796,990](../SOURCES.md#F-bc0c43ed0c)
rows ([99.8](../SOURCES.md#F-4efaf92e72)%)**: the field holds a single visit date, not a station lifespan — class 4,
schema conflation, a column named as a validity period carrying an event date.
**HYPOTHESES.md's "Now held: the ODA register carries them" is wrong.** Presence must be
derived from the observation record itself, as above. (Flagged, not edited here.)

## 3. The null, under the constraint actually imposed

The constraint is *fixed station set × fixed season window*, which shrinks n from [30,460](../SOURCES.md#F-addffbfd56)
to [8,485](../SOURCES.md#F-26b2cd9b92) and clusters it into [64](../SOURCES.md#F-1830414ba7) groups. The relevant null is therefore **not** the
sampling distribution of a median over [8,485](../SOURCES.md#F-6dbfecabd6) independent draws, and no published standard
error applies. Compute it:

**Primary null.** `H0`: the pooled trajectory is what the fixed network would have shown.
Cluster bootstrap over the [64](../SOURCES.md#F-5b340d700a) panel stations — resample [64](../SOURCES.md#F-10649719fb) *with replacement*, carry each
station's entire era-by-era Jun–Sep observation set, recompute Δ_fixed(e) = med(e) −
med(1985–1989). [5,000](../SOURCES.md#F-5cc594845c) replicates give a percentile band per era; reject `H0` where
Δ_pooled(e) falls outside the [95](../SOURCES.md#F-dd1bc9dfdb)% band. The station is the resampling unit because
observations are not independent within it; resampling observations would understate the
band by roughly √(obs per station).

**Secondary null, for the season channel.** Month-stratified station-label permutation:
within each (era, calendar-month) cell, permute station labels among observations. Era n,
month composition and every visit schedule stay fixed; only the association between
*which* station and *what value* is destroyed. It will almost certainly reject — stations
differ in depth and level by construction — so it is a check on the season channel, not a
test of [I1](../hypodrafts/I1.md "Changing station network"). Do not present rejection here as support.

**Multiplicity.** Pre-register the 2020–2024 vs 1985–1989 endpoint contrast as primary;
treat the six intermediate eras as descriptive, Holm-corrected.

## 4. Procedure

1. Read `stations_series.bin` at the `oxy_bed` offset ([483,680](../SOURCES.md#F-417c420699)); decode uint16 station
   index, uint16 month index, float32 value; `year = 1980 + month//12`, calendar month =
   `month%12 + 1`. ~[1](../SOURCES.md#F-029afc5a3d) s, <[200](../SOURCES.md#F-c91afffdcf) MB.
2. Filter Jun–Sep, 1985–2024. Assign eras.
3. Balanced panel = intersection of the eight per-era station sets ([64](../SOURCES.md#F-0a7ef5551e) stations).
4. Compute Δ_pooled(e) and Δ_fixed(e).
5. Run the two nulls above. [5,000](../SOURCES.md#F-903fbf644d) × [8](../SOURCES.md#F-b48fa59a45) medians over ≤[8,485](../SOURCES.md#F-795d21b425) rows — seconds.
6. Repeat for `oxysat_bed`, `sal_bed`, `temp_bed`. Salinity and oxygen saturation are
   computed (from conductivity+temperature, and from oxygen+temperature+salinity), so
   these are not independent replications: a consistent result is one result, not four.

**On the classification circularity.** The [293](../SOURCES.md#F-a20f85cda9) / [481](../SOURCES.md#F-4e3f7cac1f) summer/year-round split was made on
each station's *whole* record, so a station that switched regime is labelled by its
aggregate — contaminated by the very time-variation under test. This design avoids the
problem rather than fixing it: the balanced panel is defined by **presence**, observable
per era, and no behavioural label enters the primary test. Any secondary analysis wanting
the regime label must assign it **within era**, which is feasible: **[395](../SOURCES.md#F-b1b6aae712) stations have
≥[12](../SOURCES.md#F-90aef402b2) observations (all months) in ≥[2](../SOURCES.md#F-37eb2e556c) eras**, [206](../SOURCES.md#F-e449eb538d) in ≥[4](../SOURCES.md#F-4f66b795d8), [33](../SOURCES.md#F-33b0b902dd) in all [8](../SOURCES.md#F-85532de6c8). Report the switch
rate before using a pooled label again.

## 5. What a result would and would not license

**Would license.** Whether, at [64](../SOURCES.md#F-1807b3d9d3) positions watched continuously for forty years, the
Jun–Sep near-bed oxygen change is the change the pooled record reports — and if not, a
quantified size for the composition contribution.

**Would not license.**
- Any statement about a water body. The [64](../SOURCES.md#F-30d96d19e9) stations are wherever they happen to be; they
  are not a designed sample of anything, and aggregating them into Vandområder would
  import the model assumption this repo refuses.
- A claim that the fixed-panel trajectory is the *true* trend. The panel is
  survivorship-selected: stations that survive forty years are plausibly main-programme
  deep-water stations, systematically unlike the ones that came and went. Holding the
  network fixed trades a composition bias for a selection bias; it does not remove bias.
  The honest reading of agreement is "turnover did not move this number", not "this is
  what the sea did".
- Anything about oxygen *causes*. Composition is an instrument question.
- Transfer to other variables, seasons, or the pre-1985 record (1980–1984 holds only [763](../SOURCES.md#F-b77648a65d)
  Jun–Sep station-months over [109](../SOURCES.md#F-4af2b075ac) stations, which is why it is excluded).

**Nothing here has been run.** The counts in §2 are verified reads of the files; no
trajectory, band or p-value is reported.
